english.title: Fail to ensure applicable aircraft has national certificate of airworthiness or a Part-21 certificate of airworthiness
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of a non-Part-21 aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), registered in the United Kingdom and which was a State aircraft but not a military aircraft when there was not in force either a national certificate of airworthiness or a Part-21 certificate of airworthiness issued by the CAA
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 37(2) and 265(7) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
were the operator or pilot in command of a non-Part-21 aircraft registered in the United Kingdom
and which was a State aircraft but not a military aircraft
